newsitem.title: USA: First Brands to buy Australia business.
newsitem.headline: First Brands to buy Australia business.

text.p: First Brands Corp said Tuesday it had agreed to buy the NationalPak business in Australia and New Zealand from National Foods Ltd for $206 million Australian, or about $159 million U.S.
The company said the acquisition will involve several First Brands subsidiaries and will get most of its financing from bank borrowings in North America, Australia and New Zealand.
The acquisition is not expected to have any significant effect on consolidated earnings from the closing date to the end of fiscal 1997, it added.
The company said the deal's closing date is expected to be in March.

NationalPak makes and markets consumer products such as plastic wrap and bags, aluminum foil and wiping cloths under the GLAD, CHUX, OSO, MONO AND ROTA brand names. Its sales during the last 12 months were about $123 million.

First Brands Corp develops, manufactures, markets and sells leading consumer products sold under the GLAD, GLAD-LOCK, STP, SCOOP AWAY, JONNY CAT, EVER CLEAN, EVER FRESH, HEARTHSIDE AND STARTERLOGG brand names.
